text: {"lessons":["My account moved up and down even when I did nothing, so I should avoid trading just to react to monthly fluctuations.","Buying the same number of shares of each stock created unequal position sizes; I should consider how much of my account each holding represents and preserve cash for future needs.","I bought all five stocks at once, but the record is too short to judge whether those trades were good; I should review each stock's history without assuming recent price moves will continue."]}
